```{r load_data}
# Load the analysis-ready, de-identified Excel workbook (see data/ and README.md).
df_clinical <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(params$data_file, sheet = "Clinical Data")
df_sample   <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(params$data_file, sheet = "Sample Data")

df_master <- df_clinical |>
  dplyr::inner_join(df_sample, by = "participant_id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    biofluid = factor(biofluid, levels = c("urine", "plasma")),
    biobank = factor(biobank, levels = c("UCSD", "MGB")),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("UCSD Training", "MGB Holdout (Baseline)",
                                       "UCSD Holdout (Pre-Surgery)", "MGB Holdout (Pre-Surgery)",
                                       "UCSD Holdout (Surveillance)")),
    cancer_status = factor(cancer_status,
                           levels = c("Non-Cancer/Benign", "Bladder Cancer/UTUC")),
    cancer_type = factor(cancer_type, levels = c("Non-Cancer", "Benign",
                                                 "BC", "NMIBC", "MIBC", "UTUC")),
    grade = factor(grade, levels = c("Low Grade", "High Grade")),
    tstage = factor(tstage, levels = c("T0", "Tis", "Ta", "T1", "T1a", "T1b",
                                       "T2", "T2a", "T2b", "T3", "T3a", "T3b",
                                       "T4", "T4a", "T4b")),
    tstage_surgery = factor(tstage_surgery, levels = c("T0", "Tis", "Ta", "T1", "T1a", "T1b",
                                                       "T2", "T2a", "T2b", "T3", "T3a", "T3b",
                                                       "T4", "T4a", "T4b"))
  )

baseline_filter <- function(df) {
  df |> dplyr::filter(cohort %in% c("UCSD Training", "MGB Holdout (Baseline)"))
}
urine_baseline_filter <- function(df) {
  df |> baseline_filter() |> dplyr::filter(biofluid == "urine")
}
urine_training_filter <- function(df) {
  df |> dplyr::filter(cohort == "UCSD Training", biofluid == "urine")
}

format_pct_stat <- function(n1, n2, method = "wilson", accuracy = 1) {
  stat <- n1 / n2
  ci <- DescTools::BinomCI(n1, n2, method = method)[2:3]
  return(list(pct = stat,
              pct_lci = ci[1],
              pct_uci = ci[2],
              label = sprintf("%s (%s/%s)", scales::percent(stat, accuracy = accuracy), n1, n2),
              label_ci = sprintf("%s (%s/%s) [%s-%s]", scales::percent(stat, accuracy = accuracy),
                                 n1, n2, scales::percent(ci[1], accuracy = accuracy),
                                 scales::percent(ci[2], accuracy = accuracy))))
}

summarise_pcr_perf <- function(df, binary_col = "cancer_detected") {
  df |>
    dplyr::mutate(binary_call = .data[[binary_col]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      n_tp = sum(pcr_status == "No-pCR" & binary_call, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_fp = sum(pcr_status == "pCR" & binary_call, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_tn = sum(pcr_status == "pCR" & !binary_call, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_fn = sum(pcr_status == "No-pCR" & !binary_call, na.rm = TRUE),
    ) |>
    dplyr::rowwise() |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      Sensitivity = format_pct_stat(n_tp, n_tp + n_fn)$label_ci,
      Specificity = format_pct_stat(n_tn, n_tn + n_fp)$label_ci,
      PPV = format_pct_stat(n_tp, n_tp + n_fp)$label_ci,
      NPV = format_pct_stat(n_tn, n_tn + n_fn)$label_ci,
    )
}
```

```{r derive_subsets}
# QC-passed, one row per participant x biofluid
df_evaluable <- df_master |>
  dplyr::filter(qc_pass) |>
  dplyr::arrange(cancer_detected) |>
  dplyr::distinct(participant_id, biofluid, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Baseline cohorts with BC/NMIBC collapsed
df_baseline <- df_evaluable |>
  baseline_filter() |>
  dplyr::mutate(cancer_type = forcats::fct_collapse(cancer_type, BC = c("BC", "NMIBC")))

# Surveillance dataset (intervals pre-computed in data notebook)
df_surv <- df_evaluable |>
  dplyr::filter(cohort == "UCSD Holdout (Surveillance)")

# Pre-Surgery dataset (wide: one row per participant, urine + plasma columns)
df_pcr <- df_evaluable |>
  dplyr::filter(grepl("Pre-Surgery", cohort)) |>
  dplyr::select(participant_id, biobank, cancer_type, age, sex,
                tstage, tstage_surgery, tnm_surgery, pcr_status,
                had_neoadjuvant_therapy) |>
  dplyr::distinct(participant_id, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    df_evaluable |>
      dplyr::filter(grepl("Pre-Surgery", cohort), biofluid == "urine") |>
      dplyr::select(participant_id, median_tmef, cancer_detected, cancer_score)
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    df_evaluable |>
      dplyr::filter(grepl("Pre-Surgery", cohort), biofluid == "plasma") |>
      dplyr::select(participant_id, median_tmef, cancer_detected, cancer_score),
    by = "participant_id", suffix = c("_urine", "_plasma")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    cancer_type = forcats::fct_drop(cancer_type),
    cancer_detected_urine_or_plasma = cancer_detected_urine | cancer_detected_plasma
  )
```

```{r figure_assay_training, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 3}
ls_assay_metric <- list(
  "cfdna_concentration" = "cfDNA Concentration (ng/ml)",
  "cfdna_yield" = "cfDNA Yield (ng)",
  "analysis_filtered_fragment_lengths_stats_mean" = "Mean Fragment Length"
)

ls_fig_assay <- ls_assay_metric |>
  purrr::imap(function(metric, metric_col) {
    pl <- df_master |>
      dplyr::filter(cohort == "UCSD Training") |>
      dplyr::mutate(cancer_status = forcats::fct_recode(
        cancer_status,
        "Non-Cancer/\nBenign" = "Non-Cancer/Benign",
        "Bladder Cancer/\nUTUC" = "Bladder Cancer/UTUC"
      )) |>
      ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes_string(x = "cancer_status", y = metric_col,
                                          color = "biofluid")) +
      ggplot2::geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      ggplot2::geom_jitter(size = 1, shape = 1, position = ggplot2::position_jitterdodge()) +
      ggplot2::labs(x = "", y = metric) + biofluid_color
    if (metric_col %in% c("cfdna_yield", "cfdna_concentration")) {
      pl <- pl +
        ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", breaks = 10^seq(0, 4),
                                    labels = c(1, 10, 100, as.expression(bquote(10^3)),
                                         as.expression(bquote(10^4)))) +
        ggplot2::annotation_logticks(sides = "l")
    }
    return(pl)
  })

patchwork::wrap_plots(ls_fig_assay, guides = "collect", nrow = 1) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A') +
  patchwork::plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

```{r}
assay_stat <- function(df, col_by) {
  df |> gtsummary::tbl_summary(
    by = col_by,
    include = c(cfdna_concentration, cfdna_yield,
                analysis_on_binary_target_coverage_stats_mean,
                analysis_filtered_fragment_lengths_stats_mean),
    label = ls_assay_metric,
    digits = gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ 1,
    statistic = list(c(cfdna_concentration, cfdna_yield) ~
                       "{median} ({p25}, {p75}) [{min}, {max}]",
                     c(analysis_on_binary_target_coverage_stats_mean,
                       analysis_filtered_fragment_lengths_stats_mean) ~
                       "{mean} ({sd})")
  )
}
df_master |>
  dplyr::filter(cohort == "UCSD Training") |>
  dplyr::arrange(participant_id, biofluid) |>
  dplyr::mutate(.by = biofluid, id = dplyr::row_number()) |>
  dplyr::filter(.by = id, dplyr::n() == 2) |>
  assay_stat("biofluid") |>
  gtsummary::add_p(test = list(
    c(cfdna_concentration, cfdna_yield) ~ "paired.wilcox.test",
    c(analysis_on_binary_target_coverage_stats_mean,
      analysis_filtered_fragment_lengths_stats_mean) ~ "paired.t.test"),
    group = id) |>
  gtsummary::modify_caption("UCSD Training Assay Stats: by Biofluid")

df_master |>
  dplyr::filter(cohort == "UCSD Training") |>
  gtsummary::tbl_strata(
    strata = cancer_status,
    .tbl_fun =
      ~ .x |>
      dplyr::arrange(participant_id, biofluid) |>
      dplyr::mutate(.by = biofluid, id = dplyr::row_number()) |>
      dplyr::filter(.by = id, dplyr::n() == 2) |>
      assay_stat("biofluid") |>
      gtsummary::add_p(test = list(
        c(cfdna_concentration, cfdna_yield) ~ "paired.wilcox.test",
        c(analysis_on_binary_target_coverage_stats_mean,
          analysis_filtered_fragment_lengths_stats_mean) ~ "paired.t.test"),
        group = id)
  ) |>
  gtsummary::modify_caption("UCSD Training Assay Stats: by Biofluid among Cancer/Non-cancer")
```

# Baseline Sensitivity/Specificity
```{r table_performance}
summarise_sens_spec <- function(df_sample) {
  n_tp <- sum(df_sample$cancer_status == "Bladder Cancer/UTUC" & df_sample$cancer_detected)
  n_fp <- sum(df_sample$cancer_status == "Non-Cancer/Benign" & df_sample$cancer_detected)
  n_fn <- sum(df_sample$cancer_status == "Bladder Cancer/UTUC" & !df_sample$cancer_detected)
  n_tn <- sum(df_sample$cancer_status == "Non-Cancer/Benign" & !df_sample$cancer_detected)
  ls_sensitivity <- format_pct_stat(n_tp, n_tp + n_fn)
  ls_specificity <- format_pct_stat(n_tn, n_tn + n_fp)
  data.frame(sensitivity = ls_sensitivity$pct, sensitivity_lci = ls_sensitivity$pct_lci,
             sensitivity_uci = ls_sensitivity$pct_uci,
             sensitivity_label = ls_sensitivity$label,
             sensitivity_label_ci = ls_sensitivity$label_ci,
             specificity = ls_specificity$pct, specificity_lci = ls_specificity$pct_lci,
             specificity_uci = ls_specificity$pct_uci,
             specificity_label = ls_specificity$label,
             specificity_label_ci = ls_specificity$label_ci)
}

df_performance <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  df_baseline |> dplyr::group_by(biofluid, cohort) |>
    dplyr::group_modify(~summarise_sens_spec(.x), .keep = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(cancer_type = "All UC"),
  df_baseline |> dplyr::filter(cancer_type %in% c("BC", "UTUC")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(cancer_type = as.character(cancer_type)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(biofluid, cohort, cancer_type) |>
    dplyr::group_modify(~summarise_sens_spec(.x), .keep = TRUE),
  df_baseline |> dplyr::filter(cancer_type %in% c("BC", "UTUC")) |>
    dplyr::group_by(biofluid, cohort, grade) |>
    dplyr::group_modify(~summarise_sens_spec(.x), .keep = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(cancer_type = "All UC"),
  df_baseline |> dplyr::filter(cancer_type %in% c("BC", "UTUC")) |>
    dplyr::mutate(cancer_type = as.character(cancer_type)) |>
    dplyr::group_by(biofluid, cohort, cancer_type, grade) |>
    dplyr::group_modify(~summarise_sens_spec(.x), .keep = TRUE)
) |> dplyr::ungroup()

df_performance |>
  dplyr::arrange(cohort, cancer_type, grade, biofluid) |>
  dplyr::select(biofluid, cohort, cancer_type, grade,
                sensitivity_label_ci, specificity_label_ci) |>
  gt::gt("Performance in baseline samples")
```

# UCSD Surveillance

```{r}

format_ppv_npv <- function(ci_result, caption = "PPV / NPV") {
  data.frame(
    Metric = c("PPV", "NPV"),
    Estimate = scales::percent(c(ci_result$ppv["ppv_est"], ci_result$npv["npv_est"]),
                               accuracy = 0.1),
    `95% CI` = c(
      sprintf("[%s, %s]",
              scales::percent(ci_result$ppv["ppv_l"], accuracy = 0.1),
              scales::percent(ci_result$ppv["ppv_u"], accuracy = 0.1)),
      sprintf("[%s, %s]",
              scales::percent(ci_result$npv["npv_l"], accuracy = 0.1),
              scales::percent(ci_result$npv["npv_u"], accuracy = 0.1))
    ), check.names = FALSE
  ) |> gt::gt(caption = caption)
}

CIfinder::ppv_npv_ci(
  sum(df_surv$recurrence_status_bsl == "Recurrence+" & df_surv$cancer_detected),
  sum(df_surv$recurrence_status_bsl == "Recurrence+"),
  sum(df_surv$recurrence_status_bsl == "Recurrence-" & (!df_surv$cancer_detected)),
  sum(df_surv$recurrence_status_bsl == "Recurrence-"),
  sum(df_surv$recurrence_status_bsl == "Recurrence+") / nrow(df_surv)) |>
  format_ppv_npv("Surveillance: PPV / NPV")
```

# ROC
```{r compute_roc_auc}
# Helper: compute ROC curve points from a data.frame with response & cancer_score
compute_roc_curves <- function(df, group_col = "cohort") {
  df |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[group_col]]) |>
    dplyr::group_map(~{
      roc_obj <- pROC::roc(response = .x$response, predictor = .x$cancer_score, direction = "<")
      data.frame(cohort = .y[[group_col]][1], tpr = roc_obj$sensitivities,
                 fpr = 1 - roc_obj$specificities)
    }) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows()
}

# Helper: compute AUC with CI from a data.frame with response & cancer_score
compute_auc_table <- function(df, group_col = "cohort") {
  df |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data[[group_col]]) |>
    dplyr::summarise(roc_obj = list(pROC::roc(response = response,
                                              predictor = cancer_score, direction = "<")),
                     N = dplyr::n(),
                     N_actual_positive = sum(response),
                     N_actual_negative = sum(!response),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::rename(cohort = !!group_col) |>
    dplyr::mutate(auc = purrr::map_dbl(roc_obj, ~as.numeric(pROC::auc(.x))),
                  auc_lci = purrr::map_dbl(roc_obj, ~as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(.x))[1]),
                  auc_uci = purrr::map_dbl(roc_obj, ~as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(.x))[3]),
                  label = sprintf("AUC = %.2f [%.2f-%.2f]", auc, auc_lci, auc_uci)) |>
    dplyr::select(-roc_obj)
}

# --- Baseline ROC (cancer detection) ---
df_roc_baseline_input <- df_baseline |>
  dplyr::filter(biofluid == "urine", cohort != "UCSD Training") |>
  dplyr::mutate(response = cancer_status == "Bladder Cancer/UTUC")

df_roc <- compute_roc_curves(df_roc_baseline_input)
df_auc <- compute_auc_table(df_roc_baseline_input) |>
  dplyr::mutate(x_pos = 0.3, y_pos = 0.15)

# --- Surveillance ROC (recurrence detection) ---
df_roc_surv_input <- df_surv |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cancer_score), !is.na(recurrence_status_bsl)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(response = recurrence_status_bsl == "Recurrence+",
                cohort = "UCSD Holdout (Surveillance)")

df_roc_surv <- compute_roc_curves(df_roc_surv_input)
df_auc_surv <- compute_auc_table(df_roc_surv_input) |>
  dplyr::mutate(x_pos = 0.3, y_pos = 0.15)

# --- Pre-Surgery ROC (residual cancer / no-pCR detection, urine) ---
df_roc_pcr_input <- df_pcr |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(cancer_score_urine), !is.na(pcr_status)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(response = pcr_status == "No-pCR",
                cohort = "Pre-Surgery (Urine)",
                cancer_score = cancer_score_urine)

df_roc_pcr <- compute_roc_curves(df_roc_pcr_input)
df_auc_pcr <- compute_auc_table(df_roc_pcr_input) |>
  dplyr::mutate(x_pos = 0.3, y_pos = 0.15)
```

```{r figure_roc, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4}
dplyr::bind_rows(df_auc, df_auc_surv, df_auc_pcr) |>
  dplyr::select(cohort, N_actual_positive, N_actual_negative, AUC = label) |>
  gt::gt("AUC in each cohort")

roc_base_layers <- list(
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray"),
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)),
```
